Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: andrii.zagriadskyi
Message:
KMS-JSON face: ECDH (DeriveSharedSecret) for clients that sign requests

A second face on the same listener, serving a subset of a widely implemented key-service JSON API (GetPublicKey, DescribeKey, ListKeys, ListAliases, DeriveSharedSecret). mTLS plus request signature, both must name the same client; new grant op derive; keys exposed only with kmsjson: true and fixed AAD mode. Neutral naming (kmsjson, arn:hsmgate:kms:...), no affiliation, vendor strings only where the wire requires them. Shared pieces moved to keyops and gate. Black-box test with the vendor's Go SDK in test/kmsjson-sdk (own module) and a CI step. Spec renamed to docs/specs/kms-json.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
